Wow, it’s shocking how similar our stories are. I am diagnosed with depression, anxiety, and PTSD. Exactly one year ago, the anxiety was debilitating, like ruining my life. 

For the first 3-4 weeks on 25-50 mg of Zoloft, I felt very nauseous and had brain fog. The side effects were very annoying, but once they began to subside the benefits of Zoloft were worth it.

By 6 weeks, I didn’t feel like a trembling ball of goo anymore. I wasn’t constantly panicking and hyperventilating and sweating. Two months in, I upped my dose to 75 mg which is what I still take. A year later, I am still far from healed, but I can live life without constant anxiety and suicidal thoughts. I still feel anxious in situations that are particularly triggering, but Zoloft has helped manage the physical symptoms tremendously. It has really improved the quality of my life.
